text: Studies computer engineering, final year, graduates 2027.
Speaks English and Hindi; reads Gujarati.
Uses a MacBook Air M1 with 8 GB memory and an Android phone.
Lives in a three-person household; the other two travel often.
Research interest: quantum optimisation and combinatorial solvers.
Keeps a paper notebook for weekly planning, reviews it Sundays.
Publish one workshop paper before the next semester starts.
Save for a new laptop; target budget around 90000 by summer.
Learn Rust well enough to read the servo sources by spring.
Prefers dark mode in every editor and terminal.
Coffee, two cups before noon, none after 4 pm.
Meetings before 10 am are declined unless urgent.
Likes plain, short replies in chat; no emoji.
Favours window seats on flights and aisle on trains.
Morning run at 6:30 on weekdays, rest day Sunday.
Meal prep happens Saturday evening; groceries Friday after work.
Study block 8-10 pm nightly, phone on the shelf.
Calls parents every Wednesday 8 pm without fail.
No meetings during the exam window each semester.
Budget for tools is capped monthly; big buys need a month's notice.
Sensitive: passport number and scan are stored only in the safe at home.
Sensitive: therapy appointments are private, never mentioned to family.
Cannot take calls during lab hours Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
Allergic to peanuts; carries an antihistamine when travelling.
Prefers trains over flights for trips under five hours.
Finish the driving licence before the internship starts.
Plays table tennis at the campus club on Saturdays.
Gifts: likes books and board games, dislikes decorative items.
Watering plants Monday and Thursday evenings.
Volunteers at the local library on the first Sunday monthly.
Never shares the home address with delivery apps; pickup point only.
Prefers written summaries over voice notes.
Uses a password manager; recovery sheet is in the bank locker.
Run a half marathon in February; training plan starts January.
Lights out by midnight on weekdays.
Indian food, medium spice, no coriander.
Owns a bicycle used for short campus commutes.
Sensitive: medication list and dosage must not leave the device.
Sibling studies architecture in another city, visits quarterly.
Laundry Wednesday nights, shared machine, book the slot by 6 pm.
Prefers email over phone calls for anything with a paper trail.
Clear the certification exam by March; two mock tests a week from December.
Camera is a mirrorless with one prime lens; edits on the laptop.
Weekly review Sunday 7 pm, plans the coming week.
Exams period: no visitors, library only, silence until results.
